{{Quote|The fewer mouths at the table, the bigger my slice of the pikatta pie.|Teyr's head of naturalization|<ref name="EGTPM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref>}}
The '''Teyrites''' were the [[Human/Legends|Humans]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Teyr/Legends|Teyr]]. Teyrites were open to tourism on their worlds, as the [[Teyr Rift]] drew millions of offworlders every [[Standard year/Legends|year]], but were openly hostile to the idea of permanent immigration. Despite welcoming tourists, entry visas to Teyr came with endless [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucracy]] and red tape.<ref name="EGTPM" />
